title: Ndị Nche nke Ubi ahụ
intro: N'ogige mara mma, otu obodo kwere nkwa dị mkpa. Mana a nwalere mkpebi siri ike ha mgbe uche Chineke tinyere aka, wee gbanwee ihe onwunwe ha ka ọ bụrụ ala tọgbọrọ chakoo.
clues: Anyị nwetara ubi bara ụba, mana anyị ghọrọ ndị mpako.
Anyị mere atụmatụ iwe ihe ubi n'esoghị ndị ogbenye kerịta ya.
Anyị malitere n'isi ụtụtụ, obi siri anyị ike na atụmatụ anyị ga-emezu.
Ma mgbe anyị rutere, anyị hụrụ na e bibiri ubi anyị n'otu abalị.
Anyị ghọtara mmejọ anyị wee malite ịta ibe anyị ụta.
Anyị mechara chegharịa, mana ihe mmụta ahụ amụtara n'oge gara aga.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Idei mmiri nke bibiri ihe niile

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Ha chegharịrị mana ha furu ubi ha
A gbanwere ha ka ha bụrụ enwe
outcome.answer: Ha chegharịrị mana ha furu ubi ha

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
